package domain

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const (
	PracticeCompetencyEvidenceSchemaV1 = "practice-task-competency-evidence.v1"
	PracticeCompetencyEvidencePolicyV1 = "practice-competency-evidence-v1"
	PracticeEvidenceReceiptSchemaV1    = "student-practice-evidence-receipt.v1"
)

type PracticeCompetencyEvidence struct {
	Target       LearningTargetRef `json:"target"`
	Correctness  float64           `json:"correctness"`
	Independence float64           `json:"independence"`
	Confidence   float64           `json:"confidence"`
	StepIDs      []string          `json:"step_ids"`
}

type PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle struct {
	Schema                  string                       `json:"schema"`
	EvidenceID              string                       `json:"evidence_id"`
	StudentID               string                       `json:"student_id"`
	TaskInstanceID          string                       `json:"task_instance_id"`
	TaskRevisionID          string                       `json:"task_revision_id"`
	SubmissionID            string                       `json:"submission_id"`
	Outcome                 string                       `json:"outcome"`
	AssistancePolicyVersion string                       `json:"assistance_policy_version"`
	HintsUsed               int                          `json:"hints_used"`
	MaxHintLevel            *int                         `json:"max_hint_level,omitempty"`
	TeacherAssistanceUsed   bool                         `json:"teacher_assistance_used"`
	Evidence                []PracticeCompetencyEvidence `json:"evidence"`
	OccurredAt              time.Time                    `json:"occurred_at"`
	PolicyVersion           string                       `json:"policy_version"`
	RequestHash             string                       `json:"-"`
}

type PracticeEvidenceReceipt struct {
	Schema        string `json:"schema"`
	EvidenceID    string `json:"evidence_id"`
	Accepted      bool   `json:"accepted"`
	PolicyVersion string `json:"policy_version"`
}

func NormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle(studentID, idempotencyKey string, input PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle) (PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.StudentID = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID))
	input.EvidenceID = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.EvidenceID))
	input.TaskInstanceID = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskInstanceID))
	input.TaskRevisionID = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskRevisionID))
	input.SubmissionID = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.SubmissionID))
	input.Outcome = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.Outcome))
	input.AssistancePolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.AssistancePolicyVersion)
	input.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PolicyVersion)
	input.OccurredAt = input.OccurredAt.UTC()
	studentID = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(studentID))
	idempotencyKey = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(idempotencyKey))
	if input.Schema != PracticeCompetencyEvidenceSchemaV1 || input.PolicyVersion != PracticeCompetencyEvidencePolicyV1 ||
		!canonicalPracticeEvidenceUUID(studentID) || input.StudentID != studentID || !canonicalPracticeEvidenceUUID(input.EvidenceID) ||
		idempotencyKey != input.EvidenceID || !canonicalPracticeEvidenceUUID(input.TaskInstanceID) || !canonicalPracticeEvidenceUUID(input.TaskRevisionID) ||
		!canonicalPracticeEvidenceUUID(input.SubmissionID) || input.SubmissionID != input.EvidenceID || input.Outcome != "passed" ||
		input.AssistancePolicyVersion == "" || len(input.AssistancePolicyVersion) > 64 || input.HintsUsed < 0 || input.HintsUsed > 1000 ||
		input.OccurredAt.IsZero() || len(input.Evidence) == 0 || len(input.Evidence) > 100 {
		return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle{}, ErrEvidenceContract
	}
	if (input.HintsUsed == 0) != (input.MaxHintLevel == nil) || input.MaxHintLevel != nil && (*input.MaxHintLevel < 1 || *input.MaxHintLevel > 7) {
		return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle{}, ErrEvidenceContract
	}
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input.Evidence))
	for index := range input.Evidence {
		item := &input.Evidence[index]
		target, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRef(item.Target)
		if err != nil || target.Version == "" || item.Correctness < 0 || item.Correctness > 1 || item.Independence < 0 || item.Independence > 1 || item.Confidence < 0 || item.Confidence > 1 || len(item.StepIDs) == 0 || len(item.StepIDs) > 100 {
			return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle{}, ErrEvidenceContract
		}
		item.Target = target
		identity := targetIdentity(target)
		if _, duplicate := seen[identity]; duplicate {
			return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle{}, ErrEvidenceContract
		}
		stepSeen := map[string]struct{}{}
		for stepIndex := range item.StepIDs {
			item.StepIDs[stepIndex] = strings.TrimSpace(item.StepIDs[stepIndex])
			if item.StepIDs[stepIndex] == "" || len(item.StepIDs[stepIndex]) > 128 {
				return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle{}, ErrEvidenceContract
			}
			if _, duplicate := stepSeen[item.StepIDs[stepIndex]]; duplicate {
				return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle{}, ErrEvidenceContract
			}
			stepSeen[item.StepIDs[stepIndex]] = struct{}{}
		}
		seen[identity] = struct{}{}
	}
	copyForHash := input
	copyForHash.RequestHash = ""
	payload, err := json.Marshal(copyForHash)
	if err != nil {
		return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle{}, err
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(payload)
	input.RequestHash = "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
	return input, nil
}

func PracticeEvidenceReducerInputs(input PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle) ([]LearningActionTargetEvidence, error) {
	if input.RequestHash == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("normalized practice evidence is required")
	}
	support := TeacherSupportIndependent
	if input.HintsUsed > 0 || input.TeacherAssistanceUsed {
		support = TeacherSupportGuided
	}
	kind, err := deriveTargetEvidenceKind(LearningEvidenceApplication, LearningActionPassed, support)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	result := make([]LearningActionTargetEvidence, 0, len(input.Evidence))
	for _, item := range input.Evidence {
		result = append(result, LearningActionTargetEvidence{
			LearningActionID: input.EvidenceID, StudentID: input.StudentID, TaskID: input.TaskInstanceID,
			Target: item.Target, EvidenceClass: LearningEvidenceApplication, Outcome: LearningActionPassed,
			SupportContext: support, Kind: kind, HintsUsed: input.HintsUsed, MaxHintLevel: input.MaxHintLevel,
			InterventionUsed: input.TeacherAssistanceUsed, TeacherPolicyVersion: input.AssistancePolicyVersion,
			MasteryPolicyVersion: MasteryPolicyVersion, OccurredAt: input.OccurredAt,
		})
	}
	return result, nil
}

func canonicalPracticeEvidenceUUID(value string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == value
}
